Changelog.Author: (github-actions[bot])
Changelog.Description:
## Changes

## 🚀 Features

- feat(autodiscovery): update GitHub Actions lockfiles @olblak (#11345)
- fix(autodiscovery): never downgrade a dependency held back by age @olblak (#11300)
- feat: detect gitea action url @olblak (#11134)
- feat(udash)!: Use Udash versioned API @olblak (#11233)
- feat(github/action): add SHA pinning for Gitea/Forgejo @ldbs (#11217)
- feat(pyprojet): Support dependency group in autodiscovery @olblak (#10992)
- feat(gitea/pullrequest): add reviewers @ldbs (#11170)
- feat(maven): autodiscovery cooldown and vulnerability support @olblak (#10991)
- feat(gitea/pullrequest): updatecli update existing pullrequest description @olblak (#11103)
- feat(gitea): add pull request auto-merge @ldbs (#11059)
- feat(gitea): authenticate from environment variables @olblak (#11109)
- feat(gitea/pullrequest): automatically closed empty pullrequest @olblak (#11102)
- feat(maven): add age and osv support @olblak (#10990)

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- fix(git): pull working branch with singlebranch @mallendem (#11266)
- fix(github): correctly wait for github api limit when expired @olblak (#11287)
- fix(autodiscovery/npm): keep exact dependency versions exact @olblak (#11288)
- fix(engine): clear push errors recovered by a later push of the same branch @Goldloli (#11067)
- fix: return an error when pipeline prepare fails @somaz94 (#11239)
- fix: fail pipelines using an scm that could not be cloned @yuminn-k (#11216)
- fix(autodiscovery/githubaction): use goyaml engine to preserve folded scalars @loispostula (#11006)
- fix(gitea): check all pages when looking up remote branches @olblak (#11093)
- fix(file,yaml): skip a searchpattern matching no file @loispostula (#10996)
- fix(dockercompose/nomad): isMatchingRule returns true if any rule matches @mnahkies (#11038)
- fix(npm): accept the repository string shorthand @loispostula (#10997)
